newsitem.title: USA: Suzuki says gets favorable design ruling.
newsitem.headline: Suzuki says gets favorable design ruling.

text.p: A federal appeals court in Denver has ruled in favor of American Suzuki and its parent company, Suzuki Motor Corp of Japan, in a case that alleged that the Suzuki LT500R all-terrain vehicle is defectively designed, the company said Wednesday.
The case, William English vs. Suzuki Motor Corp, involved a 1991 accident in which English was riding the Suzuki ATV on sand dunes near St. Anthony, Idaho, Suzuki said.

In ruling for Suzuki, the court of appeals affirmed a jury verdict rejecting all the claims advanced by the operator, including claims that the vehicle is unstable, a news release issued by the company said.
English could not be reached for comment.
